limitations: Characteristic zero; this specified recursive weighted-projective family; no general Fano mld theorem. Literature risk of an implicit earlier use of the toric age formula. Exact finite checks do not prove universal quantifiers.
scientific_integrity: The exact boundary-free threshold and minimizing-center locus are proved here. The weighted family, pair threshold and volume asymptotic are prior work; no classification of all minimizing valuations is claimed.
title: Exact intrinsic minimal log discrepancy and its unique center in a sharp-volume toric family
